label: Pérez-Mañá 2022
setting: public hospital ophthalmology consultation (Hospital de la Esperanza, Parc de Salut Mar) and private ophthalmology clinic (Institut Català de la Retina), Barcelona
diagnosis_mix: visual impairment group (n=170): dry AMD 25.3% (n=43); exudative AMD 32.9% (n=56); cataracts 28.2% (n=48); glaucoma 11.2% (n=19); diabetic retinopathy 8.8% (n=15); other 12.9% (n=22); healthy controls n=195
recruitment: consecutive patients attending ophthalmology consultation; stable visual parameters (VA change <0.1 logMAR in last 6 months); visual impairment vs healthy groups defined by best-corrected VA (clear-cut cases and controls, authors note possible overestimation of accuracy); public hospital n=257 (119 VI, 138 healthy), private clinic n=108 (51 VI, 57 healthy); dates NR
notes: Overall age, sex not given: VI group age 78.8 +/- 10.0 y, 47.7% men/52.3% women (n=170); healthy group 68.7 +/- 11.5 y, 42.1% men/57.9% women (n=195) (p4). Public hospital patients did SLVQOL, NEI VFQ-25 and EQ 5D-5L by telephone; private clinic SLVQOL only, face to face (p3). Item 16 excluded from IRT/factor analysis (p6). Time to administer reported in seconds by subgroup (p5-6): see effects.csv. Case-control design with extreme groups; accuracy is of a QoL questionnaire total score, not a screening item.
